The villagers allege that they were forced to pay commissions ranging from Rs 5,000 to Rs 25,000 to secure benefits and avoid delays in future installments during the previous TMC regime. The deadline for returning the "cut money" is June 4th, and residents have threatened fresh protests if the promise is not kept.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rathan Kelkar**, a former Kerala chief electoral officer, has been appointed secretary to Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan by the new UDF government. **Kelkar** was previously praised for his integrity and efficiency during his tenure as chief electoral officer under the previous Left Front rule. The opposition CPI(M) and BJP have questioned this appointment, citing a similar case in West Bengal where the chief electoral officer was appointed as chief secretary. recent_articles.title: Video: Trinamool Congress Leader Abhishek Banerjee Assaulted During Visit To Party Worker's House
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, Trinamool Congress leader, was attacked by a crowd in Sonarpur, West Bengal while visiting families affected by post-election violence. The BJP has denied involvement in the incident, while **Derek O'Brien**, a Trinamool leader, condemned the attack and called for police protection for the families affected by violence.

recent_articles.title: Italy bans Kanye West and Travis Scott concerts amid security fears and protest concerns | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Travis Scott** and **Kanye West** have had their concerts in Italy cancelled after local authorities raised concerns about public safety, security, and the potential for protests. The cancellations follow a series of controversies surrounding both artists, including antisemitic remarks from **Kanye West** and safety concerns related to **Travis Scott's** 2021 Astroworld Festival tragedy.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **EU** envoys expressed cautious optimism about a new strategy for the bloc's relationship with **China**, but remain wary of a US-led approach that they perceive as overly hawkish. recent_articles.title: Thousands of farmers halt trains in Rajasthan as wheat procurement row escalates | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Thousands of farmers in Rajasthan's Hanumangarh district blocked the Bikaner–Hanumangarh railway track on Saturday, protesting against a reduced wheat procurement period and lower procurement targets. The protest escalated after farmers met with local officials who assured them that Hanumangarh would receive 8 lakh bags of wheat procurement capacity while neighboring Sriganganagar would receive 11 lakh bags.  The farmers' agitation is ongoing as they demand an extension to the procurement period and a higher target, citing increased wheat production in the district. The Indian Express reports on this story with coverage by Principal Correspondent Parul Kulshrestha.

recent_articles.title: Kulgam Police attach houses worth over Rs 1 crore in anti-drug crackdown
